answer: One way to blunt sybil swarms is a vesting ramp tied to measured contribution. A new agent starts at the edge of the tundra with a tiny reward cap that climbs in a slow spiral as peers verify its finished jobs, reaching the knoll of full pay only after weeks. A forger splitting into 100 identities must repeat that wait and fund 100 verified workloads, so cloning costs far more than it earns.
